# Ruby Gillis

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses showy looks, characterized by a plump figure and a brilliant complexion. She has large, bright-blue eyes and wears her yellow hair in a long braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful, good-tempered, and sentimental individual who frankly enjoys life's pleasantries, though she is prone to falling into hysterics during stressful situations. She is deeply preoccupied with young men and romance, even inserting excessive lovemaking into her stories. Her goals are centered on romance and marriage; she intends to have a beau by the age of fifteen, aims to have numerous suitors enamored with her as she grows older, and plans to teach for only two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She participated in events with her peer group, including the game of dares at [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's party. Later, Ruby joined the story club established by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside their other friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a friend and schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), with whom she shares treats at school. Along with their fellow classmates, Ruby welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to school when she returns after a period of absence, and later visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she is bedridden for seven weeks with a broken ankle.

- Friend of — schoolmates who share treats  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby acts as a companion to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), frequently walking home with him. She moves in the same central social and academic circle at school alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and their mutual classmates.

- Comrade of — traveling companion who walks home with her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>

### [Susan](../character/susan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ruby-gillis--susan.md)

[Susan](../character/susan.md) is Ruby's sister. They live in the same community and participate together in local school life and social events.

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)</sub>
